no_fill_leaf_projection.decision: Closed before implementation: no property-free degree-one continuous column exists.

stable_active_substitution_census.decision: Closed. Non-power-of-two pivots prevent bit-exact binary64 division, while symbolic substitution has a roughly 88x candidate-fill upper bound and repeats the already-closed stable-active alias densification.

native_indicator_model.decision: Closed. Native indicators retain every phase binary but return no exact-HZ candidate in the bounded gate.

exact_scip_mode.enable_attempt_error: SCIP was compiled without exact solve support
exact_scip_mode.official_contract: SCIP 10 exact mode can use rational, extended-precision, and safe floating-point computation and can emit independently checkable VIPR certificates when built with exact-solve dependencies.
exact_scip_mode.decision: Unavailable in the installed environment; ordinary SCIP infeasibility status is not promoted to proof authority.

disaggregated_exact_relu_slack.formulation: Introduce r=y-x in [0,-l], replace the dense x-branch by r+(-l)z<=-l, keep y<=uz, and replace x-y<=0 by the equality x-y+r=0.
disaggregated_exact_relu_slack.decision: Closed before implementation. The material nnz reduction is offset by 1,052 extra continuous columns and produces neither a usable exact-HZ candidate nor a solve-time improvement.

decision.reason: All four bounded replacements either have no common-path structure, create prohibitive fill, or return the same UNKNOWN without a usable exact witness. The installed SCIP build cannot provide exact solving or a checked infeasibility certificate.

next_action: Keep the retained projection-skip path. Do not add another linear ReLU reformulation or floating-point solver wrapper. A future exact-query replacement must begin with a proof-capable exact MIP build/certificate path or another independently checkable exact decision mechanism, remain a single common path, and cross the CIFAR100 bounded result gate before any TinyImageNet run.
